text.tspan: Common ports (1): access, infrastructure, email and the web
green = encrypted · red = clear text, passwords readable
(also clear: SNMP v1/v2c, plain LDAP; SNMPv3 encrypts)
A port is a convention (IANA, /etc/services), not a law:
SSH can run on 2222, and allowing 443 allows anything on 443.
